issues: Primary sheet bwn_na162.jpg is the GIS-Cell district map with hand-marked NA seats: NA-162=blue crayon (Chishtian), NA-163=pale yellow (Fortabbas+Haroonabad+Cholistan), NA-160 (Minchinabad+east Bahawalnagar tehsil) and NA-161 (Bahawalnagar tehsil) both uncoloured, separated by a thick hand-drawn pencil line; that line was extracted by erosion-filtering dark ink (thick strokes survive a 3px erosion, printed mouza lines do not) and the white body split into the two components.

Sheet is drawn rotated ~40-45 deg (district diagonal laid out horizontally); fit used 4 boundary anchors (SW arm west tip, south tip, NE head east/NE tips) -> affine -> trimmed affine-ICP -> TPS-ICP; outline rms 1.10 km.

The sheet draws the west Chishtian boundary (Bahawalpur side) with less westward bulge than the canvas; canvas kept as hard boundary per brief, missing bulge area classified NA-162 by nearest-label (consistent with Chishtian membership).

A green floodplain wash band along the Sutlej (north edge) carries neither seat colour nor white; it was filled by nearest-label transfer (mostly NA-161/NA-160), adding uncertainty to the NA-160/161 line near the river.

NA-162/NA-163 boundary is heavily interdigitated crayon-work on mouza limits (blue tongues into the yellow area around QH-Khiala Wala); output preserves the main tongues at ~0.4 km grid resolution, incl. one detached NA-162 pocket, faithful to the sheet.

Cross-check bwn_na163.jpg (PROPOSED MAP BY MNA APPLICANT; NA-162=pink, NA-163=green, same drawn 160/161 line) digitised with the same pipeline: per-seat IoU vs primary NA-160 0.808, NA-161 0.726, NA-162 0.866, NA-163 0.942; output shares agree within 4.3 pp — the two sheets draw the same split, with the hand-drawn 160/161 line differing by a few km locally.
bwn_na160_161.jpg is a provincial-assembly (PP-238/239/240) proposal map, not NA evidence; not used.
Sheet labels match FINAL numbering (NA-160 Bahawalnagar-I .. NA-163 Bahawalnagar-IV per data/na_2024_districts.csv); no renumbering needed.
